title: Revive Us Again
description: Revive Us Again in Tonic Solfa to REVIVE US AGAIN: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the five verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: William P. Mackay wrote the words in 1863. The tune is by John J. Husband.
underlay: We praise Thee, O God! For the Son of Thy love, For Je-sus Who died, And is now gone a-bove_. Hal-le-lu-jah! Thine the glo-ry. Hal-le-lu-jah! A-men. Hal-le-lu-jah! Thine the glo-ry. Re-vive us a-gain.

lines: For the Son of Thy love,
Who hath shown us our Saviour,
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who hath borne all our sins,
To the God of all grace,
Who hast brought us, and sought us,
Fill each heart with Thy love;
